71:922.en: 「Y-Yeah! No clue, but let's do this!」

71:1874.en: 「I can't stand being looked\ndown on from up high!」

71:1966.en: 「Like I'd lose to bastards\nwho don't even know love!!」

71:2017.en: 「Time to repay what I owe, $$ミカゲ$$!」
alternatives: Time to pay you back, Mikage!
This'll split you clean in two!

71:2127.en: 「I'll part your head from your body!」

alternatives: Like hell I'll let you escape!

71:2342.en: 「Ha ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha ha!」

71:2609.en: 「I'll put some air holes in you!」

71:2638.en: 「I'll hunt you to the ends of Earth!」

71:2673.en: 「Try and run if you think you can!」

71:2729.en: 「One of these is bound to hit!」

71:3035.en: 「Hit me, I hit back!\nThat's my way!」

71:3320.en: 「I'll do whatever I damn well please!」

71:3399.en: 「This might be more than a warning!」

71:3428.en: 「I'll knock them out of the sky!」

71:3926.en: 「I can't let Wreck cry,\nnow can I!」

71:3998.en: 「Reason and sense are useless to me!」

71:4287.en: 「What's with this one? All for show?」

71:4471.en: 「I don't even need to dodge that!」

71:5211.en: 「That was my plan from the start!」

71:5348.en: 「Not bad!\nNow I can get serious too!」

71:5493.en: 「All of you\nkeep getting in our way!」

71:5879.en: 「Go! All of you, go beyond love!!」

71:6058.en: 「Fine. Save the fun for next fight.」

71:6148.en: 「Lame hello! Kill or quit! Shape up!」

71:6512.en: 「You said it, so prove it, $$カグラ$$!」

71:6750.en: 「Mmm, it's so hot I might burn...!」

71:6882.en: 「No way, no way! Absolutely no way!」

I'll give it all to dig this hole!

I'll dig a hole with all I've got!
